title: •_Tydirium_
caption: •_Tydirium_ (V)
game_text: May deploy (with a pilot) without presence or Force icons. May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. May forfeit a scout aboard to cancel all remaining battle damage against you.
lore: Stolen Imperial _Lambda_-class shuttle. Supposedly carried parts and technical crew. Delivered General Solo’s crack team of Rebel scouts to the forest moon of Endor.
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1999 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. 'Tydirium' italic in the slip heading and caption; 'LAMBDA' italic in the banner STARFIGHTER: _LAMBDA_-CLASS SHUTTLE. Stats POWER 2 / MANEUVER 2 / HYPERSPEED 3; deploy 2 / forfeit 4. Scomp-link ring → scomp true. Icon column: one red square with an astromech dome = nav (same icon as Gold 1 VS1 #03; printed card's icons Nav Computer + Scomp Link). Slip text matches the stub. Lore corrected from the scans: _Lambda_ italic and curly apostrophe in Solo’s (wiki plain/straight) — confirmed on the 745 px V18 remake. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright (Endor, 1999) not legible. Modern: V18-L-tydirium.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 18 remake); V18-L-tydirium_ai.gif (AI-art alternate) and VB3 (350) also exist, not downloaded. Printed title on the scan is italic Tydirium.
